overview.purpose_zh: 用矩形面积比较各能源的份额，并用大分区显示 Fossil、Renewable、Nuclear 三个大类的合计。
works_zh: 适合看两层构成：大类里再分小类
适合项目不多的两层构成，快速看谁大谁小
uses_zh: 能源结构或成本结构的汇报
市场份额按品类拆分的说明

understanding.read_zh: 先看三个大分区的面积，比较三个大类的总量；再看分区内部最大的矩形。面积给的是比例印象，精确份额要读标签上的数字。

elements.note_zh: 矩形的面积等于该能源占发电总量的比例。
同属一个大类的矩形挨在一起，合成一个更大的区域。
矩形上写能源名称和份额数字，读的时候以标签为准。
颜色把同一大类里的能源归在一起，方便先看大块再看小块。

look_for_zh: 每个分区内部最大的那个矩形

observations.en: Fossil fuels take 51% of generation, just over half the total.
observations.zh: 化石能源占发电量的 51%，略高于总量的一半。

observations.en: Coal is the largest single rectangle at 26%, followed by Gas at 22%.
observations.zh: 煤炭是最大的单个矩形，占 26%，其次是天然气的 22%。

observations.en: Renewables together reach 35%, well below Fossil at 51%.
observations.zh: 可再生能源合计达到 35%，明显低于化石能源的 51%。

observations.en: Nuclear contributes 14%, more than Solar at 8%.
observations.zh: 核能贡献 14%，高于太阳能的 8%。

observations.en: Oil is the smallest block at 3%.
observations.zh: 石油是最小的方块，只占 3%。

describe.en: The chart breaks total generation down by source and groups the sources under Fossil, Renewable and Nuclear.
describe.zh: 这张图把总发电量按能源拆开，并把各能源归到 Fossil、Renewable 和 Nuclear 三个大类下。
alternatives: The treemap breaks generation down by source and group.
It shows the share of each source inside three larger groups.
describe.note_zh: 先说两层结构，再说面积代表份额，读者才知道该先看大区还是先看小块。

describe.en: Fossil fuels account for 51% of generation, with Coal alone at 26%.
describe.zh: 化石能源占发电量的 51%，其中仅煤炭就有 26%。
describe.pattern: X accounts for + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: Fossil fuels make up 51% of generation.
Coal accounts for 26% on its own.
describe.note_zh: 大类和单个能源要分开说，51% 是三个矩形相加的结果。

describe.en: Renewables account for roughly one-third of generation, at 35%.
describe.zh: 可再生能源约占发电量的三分之一，为 35%。
alternatives: Renewables make up roughly one-third of the total.
About a third of generation comes from renewable sources.
describe.note_zh: 35% 可以说 roughly one-third，但不要说成 exactly one-third。

describe.en: Coal generates more than twice as much electricity as Solar, at 26% against 8%.
describe.zh: 煤炭的发电份额是太阳能的两倍多，分别为 26% 和 8%。
describe.pattern: A + verb + more than twice as much as + B
alternatives: Coal's share is more than twice Solar's.
describe.note_zh: 倍数比较的两个对象要同属一个层级，这里都是单个能源。

describe.en: The largest proportion of generation comes from Coal, at 26%, inside the 51% Fossil group.
describe.zh: 发电量中占比最大的单项是煤炭，为 26%，它属于占 51% 的化石能源大类。
describe.pattern: The largest proportion of X comes from Y
alternatives: Coal is the largest single source at 26%.
The biggest rectangle in the chart is Coal.
describe.note_zh: largest proportion 说的是单项，不要和最大的大类混为一谈。

describe.en: What stands out is the Fossil group, whose rectangles fill just over half the chart at 51%.
describe.zh: 最显眼的是化石能源大区，它的矩形合计占整张图的一半多一点，为 51%。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun phrase
alternatives: The most noticeable feature is the size of the Fossil group.
Fossil fuels dominate the chart at 51%.
describe.note_zh: what stands out 后面接名词或名词从句，不要直接接完整的句子。

academic.en: The treemap shows how total electricity generation is divided by source, with rectangle area proportional to share and sources grouped under Fossil, Renewable and Nuclear. Fossil fuels form the largest group at 51%, just over half of generation. Within this group, Coal accounts for 26% and Gas for 22%, while Oil contributes only 3%. Renewables total 35%, made up of Hydro at 15%, Wind at 12% and Solar at 8%. A single block is assigned to Nuclear, at 14%. The layout thus separates a dominant fossil group from a renewable group about two-thirds its size.
academic.zh: 这张矩形树图展示总发电量如何按能源划分，矩形面积与份额成正比，各能源归入 Fossil、Renewable 和 Nuclear 三个大类。化石能源是最大的大类，占 51%，略高于发电总量的一半。在这一类中，煤炭占 26%，天然气占 22%，石油只贡献 3%。可再生能源合计 35%，由水电 15%、风电 12% 和太阳能 8% 组成。核能单独成块，占 14%。这样的布局把占主导的化石能源大类与规模约为其三分之二的可再生能源大类区分开来。

business.en: Our carbon plan has to start where the volume is: fossil fuels still supply 51% of electricity, with Coal at 26% and Gas at 22% of generation. Renewables are at 35%, with Hydro at 15% ahead of Wind at 12% and Solar at 8%, while Nuclear provides 14%. The grouped layout lets us compare those three blocks at a glance. We should put our next round of effort into the renewable block, because it is still smaller than the fossil one.
business.zh: 我们的减碳计划必须从量大的地方开始：化石能源仍供应 51% 的电力，煤炭占 26%，天然气占发电量的 22%。可再生能源为 35%，其中水电 15%，领先风电的 12% 和太阳能的 8%，核能提供 14%。分组布局让我们一眼就能比较这三个大块。我们应把下一轮投入放在可再生能源这一块，因为它仍然小于化石能源。

simple.en: This chart shows where the electricity comes from. Fossil fuels make 51% of it. Coal is the biggest source at 26%, and Gas is next at 22%. Oil is only 3%. Renewables together are 35%: Hydro is 15%, Wind is 12% and Solar is 8%. Nuclear is 14%. Bigger shares get bigger boxes, so we can spot the big pieces fast and check the small ones by their labels.
simple.zh: 这张图展示电从哪里来。化石能源占 51%。煤炭是最大的来源，占 26%，天然气其次，占 22%。石油只有 3%。可再生能源合计 35%：水电 15%，风电 12%，太阳能 8%。核能是 14%。份额越大，方块越大，所以大块一眼就能找到，小块要看标签。

language_notes.body_zh: 矩形树图用面积编码份额，人眼估面积不如估长度准。差距小的时候不要凭方块大小下结论，要读标签上的数字。
examples: Coal covers 26% of the treemap, Gas 22% and Oil 3%.
The Coal block looks far larger than the Oil block.

language_notes.body_zh: 大分区是大类合计，矩形是小类数值。煤炭 26、天然气 22、石油 3 加起来就是化石能源的 51。说大类时用合计，说来源时用单个矩形。
examples: Fossil totals 51% across Coal, Gas and Oil.
Renewable totals 35% across Hydro, Wind and Solar.
